items.title: Seagate Soars 6%, Coherent Up 8% as AI Stocks Rebound on Anthropic IPO Day
items.summary: Key TakeawaysSeagate jumped 6% today as AI hardware stocks rebounded on the day of Anthropic’s IPO, and Coherent rose with it. Seagate had no news of its own, and its swings have tracked AI sentiment more than its business.

items.title: Applied Optoelectronics Rallies 5% Despite $550 Million Share Sale Plan; Coherent Jumps 8%, Lumentum Climbs 4%
items.summary: Applied Optoelectronics just filed its fourth stock-sale program of the year, yet buyers keep showing up. Behind the shrug at dilution sits a hyperscale contract, a capacity race, and a CFO warning that ties every new share to production.
